subject: Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large

messages.author: 24a87515af049686
messages.subject: Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large
parts:
Dear Dr Karl
I'm trying to construct a linkage map with OneMap tutorial using R, when trying to make an order for markers using orde.seq  it showed me warning message
Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large
as the figure frame is large while the R graphics plot area not enough for it.
how can I adjust R to be able to take all the frame?
Any help will be appreciated.
thank you

messages.author: 96353e7106735838
messages.subject: Re: [Rqtl-disc] Error in plot.new() : figure margins too large
parts:
Try making the plot device bigger. 

It would help if you showed the exact line of code that gave the error, but note that OneMap is written by a separate group and you might want to ask them.

karl
